title: Update
running_since: Running {version} since 11 August. Updates are yours to start — nothing installs itself on a machine that answers a business phone.
verdict_default_title: {version} is available, and one change will break something of yours
verdict_default_body: Read the breaking change before you start — your webhooks stop working until you adjust them. Everything else is safe to take.
verdict_security_title: {version} fixes a security problem in the web interface
verdict_security_body: An unauthenticated request could read call transcripts if the interface is exposed to the internet. If yours is only on the business network you are not at risk today, but install it this week regardless.
verdict_current_title: You are on the current release
verdict_current_body: Nothing to do. Tel-Agent checks nightly and emails you only when something is worth installing.
running_note: The line stays up until step 5. From there it drops for about 40 seconds — callers in that window hear it ring out, so this is worth doing at lunchtime rather than at nine in the morning.
change_webhooks_title: Webhook payloads move to a versioned envelope
change_webhooks_body: Anything reading call.ended needs a one-line change: the body is now under data. Your two webhooks both hit wagner-partner.at, so this is on you before you update, not after.
change_reindex_title: Transcripts are re-indexed for the new search
change_reindex_body: Runs once, about 4 minutes for your 312 MB. Search returns nothing while it runs; calls are unaffected.
change_hold_title: Two callers can be on hold at the same time
change_hold_body: Until now a second caller heard the line ring out while you were on the first.
change_hours_body: Morning and afternoon on the same day, which is how most businesses actually run.
change_housenumbers_title: The agent no longer reads out house numbers as dates
change_housenumbers_body: “Nußdorfer Straße 12” was being spoken as “the twelfth”.
change_sip_title: SIP re-registers immediately after the router reconnects
change_sip_body: It used to wait for the full interval, leaving the line dead for up to an hour.
change_unauth_body: A crafted request to the web interface could return transcripts without signing in. Only reachable if the interface is exposed beyond your own network.
change_cookies_title: Session cookies are rejected over plain HTTP
change_cookies_body: They were accepted on a self-signed setup, which meant anyone on the business wifi could reuse one.
preflight_snapshot_note: Automatic, before the database is touched. 1.4 GB to the business NAS.
preflight_disk_note: Needs 2.1 GB for the new containers. 58 GB free.
preflight_idle_note: Nothing is live right now. If a call starts, the update waits for it to end rather than cutting it off.
preflight_webhooks_note: Both point at wagner-partner.at and read the old payload shape.
rollback_body: A snapshot is taken automatically before the database is touched, and the previous version stays on disk. Rolling back is one button and takes about a minute — the same minute of downtime as the update itself.
notify_note: An email when one is available. Security fixes are marked as such — those are worth interrupting a working day for.
current_body: {version} is the current release. Checked an hour ago; checked again every night. There is no need to visit this page unless an email tells you to.
history_142: Current. Security fix in the web interface.
history_141: WhatsApp voice notes, calendar conflict handling.
history_134: Rolled back after 20 minutes — the German voice model would not load.
